data.name: Kanhiyalal
data.gender_notes: Kanhiyalal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name 'Kanhiyalal' is derived from Sanskrit words ‘Kanh’ which means Lord Krishna and ‘Yaal’ which means yard or abode. This name signifies that the person is residing in the abode of Lord Krishna or is protected by him. The name Kanhiyalal carries the meaning “Lord Krishna's Yard” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kanhiyalal usually hope their child will grow to embody lord krishna's yard and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Lives in the abode of Lord Krishna
data.etymology: Kanhiyalal belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord Krishna's Yard.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kanhiyalal total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

historical_references.reference: Kanhiyalal is also known as Kanha-yarl Panini, indicating his expertise in the Sanskrit language and grammar. He is believed to have written several commentaries on Panini's Ashtadhyayi, an influential Sanskrit grammar text.
